youtube.title: IELTS prep for free? EduAbroad IELTS Test Kit
youtube.description:
Try this free IELTS kit before you pay for coaching.

EduAbroad's IELTS Online Test Kit has a free full-length mock test (151 minutes, all 4 modules, with feedback), 25 IELTS vocab flashcards, sample tasks, and common failure patterns. For the mock test you sign up and select the IELTS course.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com/ielts-online-test-kit

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
